objective_for_doctor:
Age: 47
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: intense coughing fits

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: I’m a 47-year-old woman with metastatic cancer. I’ve been having intense coughing fits, along with significant shortness of breath or difficulty breathing. I also have sharp, violent, knife-stroke–type pain—pain that’s increased with movement and increased when I breathe in deeply—around the right side of my chest and right breast, with posterior chest wall pain on both sides that radiates to the posterior chest wall on the left. The pain intensity is about 7 out of 10, and it comes on quickly (about 8 out of 10 for the pace at which it appears).
